text:
alex: Staging canary image signing failed during base-image rebuild — cosign verify errors. Anyone on call?


deploy-bot: [CI] image-sign-canary failed (job 4821) — cosign: signature verification failed for registry.redwood.internal/base-image:staging :warning:


maria: ping @sec-oncall @jamal. paste the cosign output?


alex: paste: ```shell
cosign verify --key gcpkms://projects/rw/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/img-signer 
registry.redwood.internal/base-image:staging
Error: no matching signatures found
``` 


sec-oncall: likely KMS auth/role issue or key version disabled. Did we rotate the signer key last night? KMS audit shows Unwrap failed for principal serviceAccount:image-signer@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com


jamal: we rotated KEK for staging at 00:30 to address CVE pipeline — thought we updated bindings. I'll check and re-bind `roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier` to the image-signer SA. Running: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/rw/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/img-signer --member=serviceAccount:image-signer@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier`


maria: compliance note: keep key access audit events for 90 days. Also we need to capture cosign verification attempts in the console so we can show chain-of-custody for the build.


alex: immediate plan: 1) jamal rebinds SA 2) re-run canary 3) if still fails, fallback: allow legacy key v12 for 24h and auto-retry 4) postmortem and update playbook. Any blockers?


sec-oncall: :thumbsup: agree. I'll draft a short rollback/playbook and own the postmortem. Add alerting to console: if cosign verification fails >1/min for same signer, page sec-oncall.


jamal: rebind done, re-triggering CI now.


deploy-bot: [CI] image-sign-canary retriggered by jamal (job 4822)


deploy-bot: [CI] image-sign-canary passed (job 4822) :white_check_mark:


alex: nice thanks team. follow-up: add a small integration test that runs `cosign verify` against staging signer after any key rotation and include in rebase checklist.
